name: chartlink
description: Creates charts, maps and tables and publishes them as live embeds, PNGs and share pages. The chartlink MCP server (27 tools: sign up for a key, read a type's schema, create from data rows with a rendered preview, patch, replace data or attach a refetching CSV/JSON URL, publish, templates, brands, edit links) plus a skill that teaches the create → preview → publish loop.
